instruction: Navigate to slide 3 and change the font color of the "HELLO THERE!" text to white.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated to slide 5, selected 2 shapes, opened Format > Character > Font Effects, set font color to #FFFF00 via custom color picker, but the color change did not properly apply to all text runs.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate between slides in LibreOffice Impress, select objects with Ctrl+A, open Format > Character dialog, navigate Font Effects tab, use custom color picker with hex values, save files with Ctrl+S
metadata.failure_analysis: Model selected shapes and applied color via Character dialog, but the font color change did not persist in the saved file. The original task required changing ALL textboxes on slide 5 which added complexity.
metadata.task_rationale: Changed target to a different slide (slide 3) with a simpler single textbox containing 'HELLO THERE!'. White is a standard color available in the default palette, making it easier to apply without custom color picker.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to slide 3 and changing the 'HELLO THERE!' text font color to white (#FFFFFF). Getter extracts font color of text runs in slide 3 shape 1. Metric checks all runs match expected color with partial credit.

scoring_breakdown.font_color: 1.0 - All text runs in 'HELLO THERE!' shape have color #FFFFFF (partial credit per run)

Getter extracts font color RGB values from all text runs in the specified shape, which is the right state for verifying font color changes
